chapter: Hampton and Basie: tours and road life
title: Japanese fans and autograph requests
summary: Japanese writers cover jazz festivals and a collector has a singer autograph a box of records.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And it's still going on. Also, in

They know. They send writers and people to cover every jazz festival they have over here, every summer. There are people that come -- they must send a dozen of them over here from Japan and they cover from every magazine, all the papers and everything.
(Inaudible) very small man came in with a box almost bigger than he was (inaudible).
She didn't know she'd made that many records.
He wanted to know would she mind autographing (inaudible).
And she said she was so -- she was tired, but she was (inaudible).
But she had to do it.
So impressed that anybody cared this much that she sat down and signed every one of them.
